reason_for_order: terrain exact source bytes were frozen first; order is determined by source readiness, not observed flower-colour alignment

terrain_execution_mapping.standardization: for each of elevation, slope, TRI and VRM independently, mean 0 and population-SD 1 over all finite cells in its exact frozen EarthEnv raster
terrain_execution_mapping.endpoint_sampling: nearest containing raster cell under the exact geotransform; outside extent or nodata is missing, never zero
terrain_execution_mapping.edge_score: sqrt(mean((z_endpoint_A - z_endpoint_B)^2)) over the four fixed terrain axes
terrain_execution_mapping.edge_filter: both endpoints complete for all four axes
terrain_execution_mapping.colour_geometry: exact frozen RGFCA 200 outer realizations, k=3, within-species midrank four-group JSD
terrain_execution_mapping.per_species_statistic: partial Spearman of terrain block contrast and colour edge score controlling ranked great-circle edge distance
